# Vocabulary: win_structure

How play is bounded and evaluated.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `open-sandbox` | Open sandbox | No end state; goals are player-set. |
| `scenario-goals` | Scenario goals | Discrete scenarios with stated objectives. |
| `campaign` | Campaign | Ordered sequence of scenarios or acts with narrative. |
| `survival-duration` | Survival duration | Success is lasting as long as possible or to a set time. |
| `score-ranking` | Score / ranking | Output is a score compared against self or others. |
| `competitive-victory` | Competitive victory | Win by beating rival players or AI on defined conditions. |
| `completion` | Completion | Finite set of tasks or collections to finish. |
